scheduleName.description: Name of the schedule which determines when the simultaneous ring is in effect.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, the criteria applies to calls from anonymous callers. Value for this attribute is required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, the criteria applies to calls from unavailable callers. Value for this attribute is required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

phoneNumbers.description: The list of phone numbers that will checked against incoming calls for a match. Value for this attribute is required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

ringEnabled.description: When set to `true` simultaneous ringing is enabled for calls that meet this criteria. Criteria with `ringEnabled` set to `false` take priority.
